name: Shane Paul McGhie
biography: Shane Paul McGhie (born 26 November 1993) is an American actor. He attended the University of Southern California (USC), where he graduated with a BFA in Acting in 2016. He is known for his role as Jamal Barry in What Men Want (2019) ,which starred Taraji P. Henson, and for portraying Landon Gibson in the movie After (2019).
